widgets_values: The young warrior slowly lifts the flaming spear a few centimeters while maintaining eye contact with the camera. His eyebrows slightly move, his smile grows wider, and he naturally blinks. The fire burns vividly with floating embers and heat distortion. His ribbons and clothing gently flutter in the breeze. Slow push-in camera, slight orbit to the left about 5 degrees, close-up hero framing, cinematic lighting, volumetric smoke, dramatic shadows, anamorphic lens flare, blockbuster movie trailer style, smooth cinematic motion.
